7110.title: ACP title input ordering and regeneration diagnostics
7110.rootCauseOneLine: ACP receives instructions before user text and accepts agent-supplied titles; regeneration uses a separately selected AI service, and its error suffix is a readiness diagnostic rather than a stale title.
7110.proposedFix: Capture sanitized first-prompt and title-update events from the same external ACP agent before changing title-source policy.
7110.caveats: Both clean runs verify synthetic protocol and server boundaries; actual external provider title selection and the reported Windows environment were not reproduced. No safe simple fix established.
